    dfs.append(df)

# Since all source tables have the exact same schema as the target ['user_id', 'email', 'geo'],

target_df['geo'] = target_df['geo'].str.strip()

target_df = target_df[['user_id', 'email', 'geo']]

# Write the resulting dataframe to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_92/target_multisource.csv", index=False)
